title: AutoFit Accessories - Remove pricing content and links while preserving /pricing route

requirements.summary: Remove pricing tiers and currency amounts from the Pricing page so no package pricing is displayed anywhere.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting the former pricing route does not show any pricing tiers or prices (e.g., no "$99", "From $249", package cards with prices, etc.).
No other page shows pricing tiers or package prices.

file_operations.description: Remove the tiered pricing UI and any currency/amount strings; replace with non-pricing marketing copy that does not include package cards, tiers, or prices (compose existing UI components only; do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui).

requirements.summary: Remove the Pricing link from the main (desktop and mobile) navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Top navigation (desktop and mobile) no longer includes a link labeled "Pricing" that routes to /pricing.

file_operations.description: Update navLinks to remove the /pricing entry so both desktop and mobile navigation no longer show a "Pricing" link (keep other links intact; do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui).

requirements.summary: Remove the Pricing link from the footer Quick Links section.
acceptanceCriteria: Footer "Quick Links" section no longer includes a "Pricing" link pointing to /pricing.

file_operations.description: Remove the footer "Pricing" item from the Quick Links list so it no longer points to /pricing.

requirements.summary: Convert /pricing into a non-pricing page that directs users to request a quote via Contact, without breaking existing bookmarks.
acceptanceCriteria: /pricing remains a valid route (no blank page or runtime error).
The /pricing page contains only non-pricing copy (in English) that tells users pricing is available upon request and provides a clear call-to-action link/button to /contact.

file_operations.description: Implement a replacement /pricing view focused on 'Pricing available upon request' messaging and a clear CTA (Link/Button) to /contact; ensure it renders reliably with no runtime errors and contains no tiers/prices/currency amounts (compose existing UI components only; do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui).
